ItemID: NA; Title: Chloe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me little reason to expect the vocal music I want.
ItemID: NA; Title: Stages; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal performances appeal to me, but I would choose a more familiar sound this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20 Gospel Favourites; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Christmas listening does not necessarily mean I want a gospel collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Legends; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot tell from this title whether it fits my interests, so I would skip it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wit & Wisdom Of Andy Griffith; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for music rather than spoken humor.
ItemID: NA; Title: To All The Girls...; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not offer a strong enough connection to my recent listening to draw me in.
ItemID: NA; Title: Crazy Life; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Home Free's vocal harmonies fit my interest in The New Old Fashioned; this is the one I would try.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of Vince Gill; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Country vocals sound appealing, but I would stick with Home Free this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A vocal duet album could suit my taste, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pain Killer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in the harmony-focused sound of my latest listening right now.
